notes.title: Chapter 3 is out
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22319383/2fb18b9b862c6c77694abd223f108722580c385d.png[/img]
Upgrading to a new version gives you the following new features:
-Added 3rd chapter
-Ability to save on chapters
-4 New endings
-New soundtrack
-Many Changes in the gameplay
-Some Bugs have been fixed

Enjoy new mindblowning puzzles.
